sources.title: Agents in Microsoft Foundry
sources.shortSummary: Describes GA prompt versus hosted agents, application-owned ephemeral agents, conversation/runtime responsibilities, and toolboxes. Preview optimizer and A2A features are not tested.

sources.title: What is Toolbox in Foundry?
sources.shortSummary: Explains central tool management, MCP-compatible consumption, version promotion, and local function distinctions. Separately labels tool search and skills as Preview; the tool-search candidate preserves that label.

sources.title: Quickstart: Get started with Microsoft Foundry SDK
sources.shortSummary: Documents Foundry projects (new), Python Azure AI Projects 2.x, project endpoints, model deployment selection, and DefaultAzureCredential authentication. The instant-model Preview path is not tested.

sources.title: Manage Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry Models quota
sources.shortSummary: Defines quota allocation by subscription, region, model and deployment type; separates input context limits, billing tokens, estimated admission tokens, burst checks, and bounded retry guidance.

sources.title: Deployment types for Microsoft Foundry Models
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes data-processing boundaries, Standard pay-per-token capacity, provisioned reserved capacity, and asynchronous Batch deployments. Model/type availability must be checked.

sources.title: Prompt Shields in Microsoft Foundry
sources.shortSummary: Describes user and third-party document attacks, input/tool-response intervention points, and detected versus filtered annotations. Spotlighting is separately Preview and limited to Chat Completions.

sources.title: Use a toolbox with a hosted agent
sources.shortSummary: Documents default-following versus version-specific toolbox endpoints and the direct consuming runtime responsibility to enforce every required tool approval before invocation.

sources.title: Use function calling with Microsoft Foundry agents
sources.shortSummary: Defines function-tool name/description/parameters, client-side execution, matching function_call_output call IDs, and conversation reuse in the current prompt-agent example.

sources.title: Connect agents to Model Context Protocol servers
sources.shortSummary: Documents managed remote MCP integration, authenticated project connections, allowed_tools restrictions, approval settings, and approval-request/previous-response correlation.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) evaluators
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes standard Groundedness, Relevance, Retrieval, and Document Retrieval; explains qrels, NDCG, Fidelity, and missing-judgment Holes. Preview evaluator variants are not proposed as the tested standard evaluators.

sources.title: Agent tracing overview
sources.shortSummary: Documents GA tracing for prompt and hosted agents, timed nested spans, evaluation-run correlation, and removing sensitive inputs, tool data, and credentials before telemetry export.

sources.title: Azure OpenAI image generation models
sources.shortSummary: Documents GPT-Image-2 as GA with image editing; edit masks use PNG, matching dimensions, and transparent target pixels. Older image-model preview statuses and DALL-E retirement are distinguished.

sources.title: Use vision-enabled chat models
sources.shortSummary: Explains Chat Completions image detail low, high, and auto: reduced-resolution versus segmented high-resolution processing and their token/detail tradeoffs.

sources.title: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools video solutions
sources.shortSummary: API 2026-06-01-preview distinguishes content extraction, shot detection, custom field schemas, and semantic segmentation; documents approximate 1 FPS sampling and resized frames.

sources.title: What are sentiment analysis and opinion mining?
sources.shortSummary: Explains document/sentence sentiment and aspect-based opinion mining. Announces retirement on March 31, 2029 and recommends Foundry for new projects; the candidate covers an existing integration.

sources.title: Detect and redact Personally Identifiable Information in text
sources.shortSummary: Documents the tested 2025-11-15-preview redaction policies: characterMask preserves length/offsets, entityMask substitutes labels, syntheticReplacement substitutes values, and noMask omits redactedText.

sources.title: Implement language identification
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes recognition mode from at-start/continuous language identification, requires one locale per base language, and limits continuous identification to between-sentence language changes.

sources.title: Azure Translator in Foundry Tools dynamic dictionary
sources.shortSummary: Defines dynamic dictionary term markup, compound/proper/product-name scope, explicit From language, and a language pair containing English.

sources.title: Semantic ranking in Azure AI Search
sources.shortSummary: Describes query-side reranking of existing candidates and extractive verbatim captions/answers; semantic ranking does not synthesize missing answers or supply tenant filtering.

sources.title: Create a hybrid query in Azure AI Search
sources.shortSummary: Describes parallel keyword/vector retrieval, RRF fusion, vector k versus final top. Separately documents Preview filterOverride fully replacing global filters, including security trimming.

sources.title: Validate document analyzer quality with confidence, grounding, and labeled samples
sources.shortSummary: For GA 2025-11-01, documents field confidence/source estimates, source pages/coordinates/spans, representative labeled samples, unsupported generate-field training, and OCR errors not corrected by labels.

sources.title: Study guide for Exam AI-103: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure
sources.shortSummary: Actual AI-103 study guide effective April 16, 2026: five objective domains with published weights, skills, and subskills. Scope evidence, not implementation proof.

sources.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
sources.shortSummary: Actual credential page identifies Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate. Final active/readiness enablement remains with independent catalog verification.

sources.title: Develop AI apps and agents on Azure
sources.shortSummary: Actual course AI-103T00-A, Develop AI apps and agents on Azure, identifies Python/Foundry developer training and links the current credential.
